---
title: "Region x time with an Abrahamic term"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

How much of the change over time comes from Abrahamic groups (Christian, Islamic and Jewish; see `abrahamic` in
`1_code_entrytags.py`) replacing others? Same sample, questions and main model as `13_main.Rmd`, with one added term
for Abrahamic groups:

```
answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time + abrahamic + (1 | expert)
```

- **Region slopes** are now the change over time net of the jump between non-Abrahamic and Abrahamic groups. The
  model assumes both share a region's trend and differ in level only.
- **Comparing the slopes with those of `13_main.Rmd`** shows how much of each trend is the shift in which groups are
  present.
- **The `abrahamic` coefficient** is how Abrahamic groups differ in log-odds, at the same region, time and expert.
- **Prior on `abrahamic`: normal(0, 2).** It is wide on purpose: the jump can take as much of the change as the data
  allow, which is the conservative direction for the slopes. Other priors as in `13_main.Rmd`.

In Southwest Asia, Europe and Africa, Abrahamic almost coincides with starting from 0 CE, and East Asia has a single
Abrahamic group. So the jump is identified mainly from the few entries that break this pattern (listed under
"Data"), from the change within each group of entries, and from East Asia.

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py` and `13_main.Rmd` (its region x time fits are the comparison).
Fits are saved in `fits/` (`abrahamic_*`; delete them to refit), figures in `fig/abrahamic/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(loo)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/abrahamic/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/abrahamic"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

regions <- c("Southwest Asia", "Europe", "Africa", "East Asia")
western <- c("Southwest Asia", "Europe", "Africa")
model_colors <- c("main (13_main)" = "#a3a29b", "with Abrahamic term" = "#8a63d2")
abrahamic_colors <- c("not Abrahamic" = "#52514e", "Abrahamic" = "#8a63d2")
year_min <- -3000
year_max <- 1500

# child questions combined into one ("Yes" if any answered question in the set is "Yes"), as in 13_main.Rmd
groups <- list(
  "murder out-group" = c("murder other religions", "murder other polities"),
  "elite ties" = c("is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty")
)
```

# Data

Same as `13_main.Rmd`, with `abrahamic` carried along.

```{r data, message = FALSE}
source_of <- read_csv("../data/sccsrv3/entry_data.csv", col_select = c(entry_id, data_source)) |>
  distinct(entry_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

d_window <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  left_join(source_of, by = "entry_id") |>
  filter(
    poll == "group",
    world_region %in% regions,
    is.na(data_source) | (data_source != "eHRAF" & !str_starts(data_source, "Pulotu")),
    year_from >= year_min, year_from < year_max
  ) |>
  mutate(region = factor(world_region, levels = regions), time = year_from / 1000)

# conflicting answers (Yes and No for the same entry and question; weight < 1) are left out
d <- d_window |> filter(weight == 1)

# parent question of each family of child questions
parent_of <- c(monitoring = "supernatural monitoring present", shg = "supreme high god present")

# child questions in topic order (as in 4_baseline.Rmd), before grouping
topic_items <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
stopifnot(setequal(topic_items, d |> filter(family != "parent") |> distinct(question_short) |> pull()))

# child questions after grouping: each set takes the place of its first question
items <- enframe(groups, name = "group", value = "question_short") |> unnest(question_short)
group_of <- setNames(items$group, items$question_short)  # question -> its set
topic_order <- unique(coalesce(unname(group_of[topic_items]), topic_items))
all_questions <- c(unname(parent_of), topic_order)

# child questions as answered; grouped sets collapsed to one answer per entry
children <- d |> filter(question_short %in% topic_items, !inferred)
grouped <- children |>
  filter(question_short %in% names(group_of)) |>
  mutate(group = unname(group_of[question_short])) |>
  group_by(question_short = group, family, entry_id, entry_name, expert, region, year_from, time, abrahamic) |>
  summarise(answer_value = as.integer(any(answer_value == 1)), .groups = "drop")

# samples (one model per question in each)
sets <- list(
  parent = d |> filter(question_short %in% parent_of), # as answered (no "No" inferred for the supreme high god since 2026-11-23)
  conditional = bind_rows(children |> filter(!question_short %in% names(group_of)), grouped)
)
runs <- bind_rows(
  tibble(set = "parent", question = unname(parent_of)),
  tibble(set = "conditional", question = topic_order)
)

questions <- bind_rows(sets) |> distinct(family, question_short)
stopifnot(setequal(topic_order, filter(questions, family != "parent")$question_short))
```

Groups by region, before and from 0 CE (start year), Abrahamic or not:

```{r data_pattern}
entries <- d_window |> distinct(entry_id, entry_name, region, year_from, abrahamic)
entries |>
  mutate(period = if_else(year_from < 0, "before 0 CE", "from 0 CE")) |>
  count(region, period, abrahamic) |>
  mutate(abrahamic = if_else(abrahamic == 1, "Abrahamic", "not_Abrahamic")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = abrahamic, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

Groups that break the pattern (Abrahamic before 0 CE, or not Abrahamic from 0 CE in Southwest Asia, Europe or
Africa); with East Asia, they carry most of the information on the jump:

```{r data_breaks}
entries |>
  filter((abrahamic == 1 & year_from < 0) | (abrahamic == 0 & year_from >= 0 & region %in% western)) |>
  arrange(abrahamic, year_from) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

Entries per question and share "Yes", Abrahamic or not:

```{r data_questions}
bind_rows(sets) |>
  group_by(question = question_short, abrahamic = if_else(abrahamic == 1, "abrahamic", "other")) |>
  summarise(n = n(), yes = round(mean(answer_value), 2), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = abrahamic, values_from = c(n, yes)) |>
  arrange(match(question, all_questions)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Model and fit

The model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each question with `update()`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
model <- bf(answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time + abrahamic + (1 | expert))

# brms names the region coefficients without spaces (regionSouthwestAsia, regionSouthwestAsia:time, ...)
region_key <- setNames(regions, str_remove_all(regions, " "))
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),  # region slopes
  reduce(map(paste0("region", names(region_key)), ~ set_prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", coef = .x)), c),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b", coef = "abrahamic"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "sd")  # half-normal on the expert SD
)

template <- suppressWarnings(brm(model, data = sets$parent, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors,
                                 chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))

fit_question <- function(set, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/abrahamic_%s_%s.rds", set, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    template,
    newdata = filter(sets[[set]], question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, seed = 125123, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

# region x time fits of 13_main.Rmd (same data, without the Abrahamic term)
read_main <- function(set, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/main_region_time_%s_%s.rds", set, question)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("missing ", path, ": run 13_main.Rmd first")
  readRDS(path)
}

fits <- runs |>
  mutate(
    fit = map2(set, question, fit_question),
    fit_main = map2(set, question, read_main)
  )
# same observations in both (needed for the comparisons below)
stopifnot(all(map2_lgl(fits$fit, fits$fit_main, ~ nrow(.x$data) == nrow(.y$data))))
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^(b|sd)_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(set, question, diag) |>
  unnest(diag)

diagnostics |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(max_rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail),
            divergences = sum(divergences))

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Estimates

```{r estimates}
summarise_draws_ <- function(value) {
  tibble(mean = mean(value), lower = quantile(value, 0.025), upper = quantile(value, 0.975), p_positive = mean(value > 0))
}

# region slopes per draw, plus their average
region_slopes <- function(fit) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_region.*:time$", regex = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(.draw, starts_with("b_")) |>
    pivot_longer(-.draw, values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(region = unname(region_key[str_remove(str_remove(name, "^b_region"), ":time$")])) |>
    select(.draw, region, value)
  average <- draws |> group_by(.draw) |> summarise(value = mean(value)) |> mutate(region = "average")
  bind_rows(draws, average)
}

add_panels <- function(est) {
  est |>
    left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
    mutate(
      panel = case_when(set == "parent" ~ "parent", family == "monitoring" ~ "monitoring", TRUE ~ "supreme\nhigh god"),
      panel = factor(panel, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "supreme\nhigh god")),
      question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions))
    )
}

# slopes, main and with the Abrahamic term
slopes <- fits |>
  pivot_longer(c(fit_main, fit), names_to = "model", values_to = "fit") |>
  mutate(
    model = factor(if_else(model == "fit", "with Abrahamic term", "main (13_main)"), levels = names(model_colors)),
    est = map(fit, ~ region_slopes(.x) |> group_by(region) |> reframe(summarise_draws_(value)))
  ) |>
  select(model, set, question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  add_panels() |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("average", regions)))

# Abrahamic coefficient, and the expert SD in both models
abrahamic_effect <- fits |>
  mutate(
    est = map(fit, ~ summarise_draws_(as_draws_df(.x, variable = "b_abrahamic")$b_abrahamic)),
    sd_main = map_dbl(fit_main, ~ mean(as_draws_df(.x, variable = "sd_expert__Intercept")$sd_expert__Intercept)),
    sd_abrahamic = map_dbl(fit, ~ mean(as_draws_df(.x, variable = "sd_expert__Intercept")$sd_expert__Intercept))
  ) |>
  select(set, question, est, sd_main, sd_abrahamic) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  add_panels()
```

## Abrahamic coefficient

Difference in log-odds between Abrahamic and other groups at the same region, time and expert (mean and 95%
interval). Dashed: ±2, one prior SD.

```{r abrahamic_effect, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 10}
p_effect <- ggplot(abrahamic_effect, aes(mean, question)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), colour = "grey80", linetype = "22") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), size = 0.15, colour = abrahamic_colors[["Abrahamic"]]) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Abrahamic vs. other groups (log-odds)", y = NULL) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
save_plot(p_effect, "abrahamic_effect", 7, 10)
```

## Average of the region slopes: main and with Abrahamic term

```{r slopes_average, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 11}
slope_plot <- function(est) {
  ggplot(est, aes(mean, question, colour = model, group = fct_rev(model))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.15) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors) +
    labs(x = "Time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
}
p_average <- slope_plot(filter(slopes, region == "average")) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
save_plot(p_average, "slopes_average", 8, 11)
```

Per question: average slope in both models, as mean [95% interval] and the probability of a positive slope; the
Abrahamic coefficient; and the expert SD (posterior mean) in both models (the Abrahamic term may take over part of
the differences between experts, since most experts code only Abrahamic or only other groups).

```{r slopes_table}
fmt <- function(mean, lower, upper) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", mean, lower, upper)
average <- slopes |>
  filter(region == "average") |>
  mutate(model = if_else(model == "main (13_main)", "main", "abrahamic"), value = fmt(mean, lower, upper),
         p = round(p_positive, 3)) |>
  select(question, model, value, p, mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(value, p, mean))
average |>
  left_join(abrahamic_effect |> transmute(question, abrahamic_effect = fmt(mean, lower, upper),
                                          sd_main = round(sd_main, 2), sd_abrahamic = round(sd_abrahamic, 2)),
            by = "question") |>
  transmute(
    question = factor(question, levels = all_questions),
    slope_main = value_main, p_pos_main = p_main,
    slope_abrahamic = value_abrahamic, p_pos_abrahamic = p_abrahamic,
    change = round(mean_abrahamic - mean_main, 2),
    abrahamic_effect, sd_main, sd_abrahamic
  ) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## Slopes per region: main and with Abrahamic term

East Asia has a single Abrahamic group, so its slopes should barely change.

```{r slopes_region, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 12}
p_region <- slope_plot(filter(slopes, region != "average")) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ region, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
save_plot(p_region, "slopes_region", 16, 12)
```

## Does the Abrahamic term improve prediction?

Leave-one-out comparison (elpd) of the model with the Abrahamic term against the main model, per question. Positive:
better with the Abrahamic term; a difference of less than about 2 standard errors is not a clear difference.

```{r loo, warning = FALSE}
# elpd of model a minus elpd of model b, as "diff (se)", from the pointwise values (as loo_compare does)
elpd_vs <- function(a, b) {
  d <- a$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"] - b$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", sum(d), sqrt(length(d)) * sd(d))
}

# one core: forking for each of the small fits can exhaust processes ("unable to fork"), and gains nothing
fits |>
  mutate(
    loo = map(fit, ~ loo(.x, cores = 1)),
    loo_main = map(fit_main, ~ loo(.x, cores = 1))
  ) |>
  transmute(
    question = factor(question, levels = all_questions),
    abrahamic_vs_main = map2_chr(loo, loo_main, elpd_vs),
    high_k = map_int(loo, ~ sum(pareto_k_values(.x) > 0.7))
  ) |>
  arrange(question) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Curves over time: Abrahamic and other groups

Check of the model's assumption that Abrahamic and other groups share the trend and differ in level only.

- **Lines:** the typical region (average region intercept and slope), averaged over experts as in `13_main.Rmd`, for
  other groups (grey) and Abrahamic groups (purple); bands: 95% intervals. Each line is drawn over the years where its
  groups have data for the question (first to last start year).
- **Points:** observed share "Yes" of Abrahamic and other groups, in 500-year bins of start year, all four regions
  pooled; size = number of entries. The two are shifted slightly around the bin midpoint.

If the points of one kind of group clearly run against its line (for example, a trend among Abrahamic groups opposite
to that of the other groups), the assumption does not hold for that question.

```{r curves}
years <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 50)
answers <- bind_rows(sets, .id = "set") |>
  transmute(set, question = question_short, entry_id, year_from, answer_value,
            kind = factor(if_else(abrahamic == 1, "Abrahamic", "not Abrahamic"), levels = names(abrahamic_colors)))

# P(yes) averaged over experts: per draw (row of eta), mean of logit^-1(eta + sigma * z) over standard-normal quantiles z
z <- qnorm(ppoints(25))
expert_average <- function(eta, sigma) Reduce(`+`, lapply(z, function(zk) plogis(eta + sigma * zk))) / length(z)
eta_grid <- function(a, b) outer(a, rep(1, length(years))) + outer(b, years / 1000)  # draws x years

curves <- fits |>
  mutate(curve = map(fit, function(fit) {
    draws <- as_draws_df(fit) |> as_tibble()
    a <- rowMeans(as.matrix(draws[paste0("b_region", names(region_key))]))
    b <- rowMeans(as.matrix(draws[paste0("b_region", names(region_key), ":time")]))
    map_dfr(c(0, 1), function(k) {
      p <- expert_average(eta_grid(a + k * draws$b_abrahamic, b), draws$sd_expert__Intercept)
      tibble(kind = names(abrahamic_colors)[k + 1], year = years, mean = colMeans(p),
             lo95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.025), hi95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.975))
    })
  })) |>
  select(set, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve) |>
  mutate(kind = factor(kind, levels = names(abrahamic_colors)))

# each line over the years where its groups have data
data_range <- answers |>
  group_by(set, question, kind) |>
  summarise(from = floor(min(year_from) / 50) * 50, to = ceiling(max(year_from) / 50) * 50, .groups = "drop")
curves <- curves |>
  inner_join(data_range, by = c("set", "question", "kind")) |>
  filter(year >= from, year <= to)

# observed share per kind of group in 500-year bins of start year
bin_edges <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 500)
offsets <- setNames(c(-40, 40), names(abrahamic_colors))
binned <- answers |>
  mutate(bin = findInterval(year_from, bin_edges)) |>
  group_by(set, question, kind, bin) |>
  summarise(share = mean(answer_value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = bin_edges[bin] + 250 + offsets[as.character(kind)])

kind_plot <- function(questions_, ncol = 6) {
  keep <- function(x) filter(x, question %in% questions_) |> mutate(question = factor(question, levels = questions_))
  lines <- keep(curves)
  ggplot(mapping = aes(year)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_ribbon(data = lines, aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95, fill = kind), alpha = 0.18, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = keep(binned), aes(y = share, colour = kind, size = n), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(data = lines, aes(y = mean, colour = kind), linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ question, ncol = ncol) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = abrahamic_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = abrahamic_colors) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 4.5, breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 40)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(year_min, year_max, by = 1000)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), xlim = c(year_min, year_max)) +
    labs(x = "Year (start year)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL, size = "entries") +
    theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
}

monitoring_questions <- c(parent_of[["monitoring"]], intersect(topic_order, filter(questions, family == "monitoring")$question_short))
shg_questions <- c(parent_of[["shg"]], intersect(topic_order, filter(questions, family == "shg")$question_short))
```

```{r curves_monitoring, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 12}
save_plot(kind_plot(monitoring_questions), "curves_monitoring", 16, 12)
```
